description.value: Gene Coffee Bar is a neighbourhood café on Main Street in Vancouver focused on specialty espresso drinks, organic pastries, and an unhurried atmosphere designed for staying a while. The space features window seating with natural light, communal benches, and a notably generous supply of power outlets popular with laptop users. Cyclists can fuel up on all-day breakfast wraps, croissant sandwiches, and a range of vegan and gluten-free baked goods.
